description: Canonical column mapping for the SIAP 'Cierre agricola' municipal files (2003-2025). Each row already carries the official SIAP territorial hierarchy Idestado -> Idddr -> Idcader -> Idmunicipio, so no external municipality-to-district crosswalk is used.

column_notes.crop: Nomcultivo in 2003-2014 and 2021-2025; 'Nomcultivo Sin Um' in 2015-2020. When both exist the unit-free name wins.
column_notes.rural_price_mxn_t: Precio in 2003-2020; Preciomediorural in 2021-2025. Current MXN per tonne.
column_notes.reported_yield_t_ha: Read for reference only. District yield is always recomputed as volume_t / harvested_ha.
